newsitem.title: USA: MAPCO still aims for 15 pct year EPS growth.
newsitem.headline: MAPCO still aims for 15 pct year EPS growth.

text.p: Petroleum refiner MAPCO Inc said Wednesday it remains committed to its earnings goal of 15 percent growth this year despite lower second-quarter earnings.
MAPCO reported an operating profit of $0.20 per share for the second quarter, against $0.31 for the same period last year. The previous year's figure excluded a divested coal segment.

"Actions necessary to execute our strategic growth plan, such as selling non-core assets, terminating a franchise agreement, and incurring increased expenses related to the implementation of growth plans, resulted in lower earnings this quarter when compared to last year," it said in a statement.
"We remain strongly committed to achieving our goal of 15 percent growth in earnings per share," it added.
First Call's consensus among analysts is a profit of $2.30 a share for 1997, against $2.27 in 1996.
